examples.en: I see one cat on the table.

examples.uz: Bu uning sumkasi va bu mening sumkam.
examples.en: This is his bag and this is my bag.

examples.uz: Men uyda uxlayman. U uyda uxlaydi.
examples.en: I sleep at home. He sleeps at home.

examples.uz: U har doim baxtli. Men har doim baxtli emasman.
examples.en: He is always happy. I am always not happy.
The dark bag is on the table.

examples.uz: Menda ikkita mushuk bor, lekin unda bitta mushuk bor.
examples.en: I have two cats, but he has one cat.

examples.uz: Men tashqarida qorong'ida ikkita odamni ko'ryapman.
examples.en: I see two people outside in the dark.

examples.uz: U har doim akasi bilan o'ynaydi.
examples.en: He always plays with his brother.

examples.uz: Men kechga qoldim. Sen kechga qolding.
examples.en: I am late. You are late.

examples.uz: U har doim kechroq, tushlikdan keyin, tashqariga chiqadi.
examples.en: He always goes outside in the late afternoon.

examples.uz: Men ishga har doim piyoda boraman.

examples.en: Do not walk in the dark.

examples.uz: Menda mashina yo'q. Uyg'a piyoda boraman.
examples.en: I do not have a car. I walk home.

story.title: Kichik hikoya
story.text: It is late and it is dark, and I see two black cats outside. His yellow car is outside too. My brother says, 'Do you always walk this late?' I say, 'Sometimes, but not always.' We walk and he says, 'What color is it?' I say, 'It is dark and I cannot see.' But I see his cat. It always sleeps on the table, but today it is outside.
